name: Kourou ELA-2
best_known_for: Primary Ariane 4 pad — flew every Ariane 4 mission (1988-2003)
credit: Fleet launch-site entry added during the cross-correlation analysis (#306 follow-up). ELA-2 (Ensemble de Lancement Ariane 2) was the workhorse pad of the Ariane 4 era, decommissioned in 2003. Distinct from ELA-3 (Ariane 5) and ELA-4 (Ariane 6).
